scripts.build:server: npm run typecheck:server && vite build --config vite.server.config.ts
scripts.build:remotion-worker:mock: npm run typecheck:server && vite build --config vite.remotion-worker.config.ts
scripts.build:staging-fixture-worker: npm run typecheck:server && vite build --config vite.staging-fixture-worker.config.ts
scripts.docker:worker:tools: docker run --rm --env API_ALLOW_MOCK_WITHOUT_SUPABASE=true --env E2E_RUNTIME_MODE=local --env WORKER_RUNTIME_MODE=local reeditpro-worker-dev npm run tools:check
scripts.docker:worker:smoke: docker run --rm --env API_ALLOW_MOCK_WITHOUT_SUPABASE=true --env E2E_RUNTIME_MODE=local --env WORKER_RUNTIME_MODE=local reeditpro-worker-dev npm run smoke:tools
scripts.docker:worker:render-smoke: docker run --rm --env API_ALLOW_MOCK_WITHOUT_SUPABASE=true --env E2E_RUNTIME_MODE=local --env WORKER_RUNTIME_MODE=local --env STORAGE_MODE=local --env STRICT_RENDER_SMOKE=true reeditpro-worker-dev npm run smoke:render
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:server && npm run start:server
